scope: 24 generated pose masters, 24 runtime-review derivatives, four six-pose contact sheets, one cross-individual comparison sheet, four room composites, and eight mobile home mockups

golden-shaded.evidence: Emerald eyes, warm gold undercoat, charcoal crown/back/tail tipping, dark tail tip, petite-cobby frame, and modest cheeks remain readable across all six poses.

blue-golden-shaded.evidence: Olive eyes, broad mature muzzle, heavier chest, pale honey undercoat, cool blue-gray veil, brow arcs, and charcoal-blue tail tip remain stable across all six poses.

solid-blue.evidence: Copper eyes, tiny wide-set ears, massive jowls, uniform slate coat, barrel torso, short thick legs, and very thick tail remain stable; no tabby or white markings appear.

blue-white-bicolor.evidence: Amber eyes, pink nose, centered inverted-V blaze, blue cap and saddle, single rounded left-shoulder spot, white legs, blue tail, and white tail tip remain recognizable through pose turns.

crossIndividualDistinctness.evidence: The comparison sheet shows four separate faces and body conditions rather than one recolored silhouette: petite golden female, broad mature blue-golden male, heaviest solid-blue male, and athletic blue-white female.

golden-shaded.sit: pass — paired forepaws and seated haunches carry weight; tail joins rump and wraps on baseline.
golden-shaded.sleep: pass — ribcage and spine form a believable curl; head rests on forepaws; tail follows the outer body without a break.
golden-shaded.walk: pass — one forepaw advances while the other forepaw and hind support remain grounded; short legs share a baseline.
golden-shaded.eat: pass — low crouch, continuous neck/back, grounded paws, bowl contact, and muzzle-to-rim interaction are believable.
golden-shaded.play: pass — one forepaw contacts yarn while the other forepaw and hindquarters support the body; raised tail has a continuous base.
golden-shaded.gaze: pass — seated pelvis supports a gentle spinal/neck turn; forepaw and tail placement keep the center of gravity inside the base.

blue-golden-shaded.sit: pass — broad chest centers over sturdy forepaws and loaded haunches; tail is continuously attached.
blue-golden-shaded.sleep: pass — broad oval curl retains heavy torso volume; crossed forepaws, tucked hindquarters, and wrapped tail read physically.
blue-golden-shaded.walk: pass — four-leg gait is readable with a forward forepaw and three supporting/transitioning limbs; no duplicated paws.
blue-golden-shaded.eat: pass — all four short legs are accounted for with natural far-side occlusion; bowl and paws share a baseline.
blue-golden-shaded.play: pass — seated haunches and planted forepaw support the raised paw on the yarn; tail counterbalances without floating.
blue-golden-shaded.gaze: pass — broad grounded haunches support the upward head turn; spine and tail remain continuous.

solid-blue.sit: pass — the heaviest torso remains centered over paired forepaws and haunches; tail forms a grounded counterweight.
solid-blue.sleep: pass — deep curl compresses the barrel torso believably; stacked forepaws and outer tail support the silhouette.
solid-blue.walk: pass — low slow gait preserves cobby mass, short load-bearing legs, level spine, and a continuous low tail.
solid-blue.eat: pass — low center of gravity, broad shoulder support, tucked hindquarters, bowl contact, and tail continuity are plausible.
solid-blue.play: pass — sphinx-like crouch keeps chest and hindquarters grounded while one forepaw touches the yarn.
solid-blue.gaze: pass — broad seated base supports the profile head turn; one forepaw is visible and hidden limbs are plausibly occluded.

blue-white-bicolor.sit: pass — upright torso, paired white forepaws, haunches, and wrapped tail create a stable seated base.
blue-white-bicolor.sleep: pass — cheek rests on forepaws; hindquarters and continuous blue tail form a grounded crescent.
blue-white-bicolor.walk: pass — lifted forward forepaw is balanced by three grounded limbs; shoulder, pelvis, and tail alignment are believable.
blue-white-bicolor.eat: pass — four legs are present with natural far-side occlusion; bowl and paws share one baseline and the muzzle clears the rim.
blue-white-bicolor.play: pass — one forepaw contacts the yarn, opposite forepaw and both hindquarters support the bow, and tail rises continuously from the rump.
blue-white-bicolor.gaze: pass — seated base, visible forepaw, neck turn, and low wrapped tail keep the center of gravity stable.

sharedFailureChecks.missingLoadBearingPaws: none observed; hidden limbs use plausible pose occlusion
sharedFailureChecks.detachedEffects: none present; bowls and yarn balls are state-relevant props in physical contact

golden-shaded.mobile390: pass — sleep silhouette rests on the rug with no visible gap and remains clear of bowls, cat tree, table, and navigation.
golden-shaded.mobile430: pass — scale remains petite but breed-readable; baseline and rug contact remain stable.

blue-golden-shaded.mobile390: pass — broader sleep silhouette is grounded and remains inside the rug safe area.
blue-golden-shaded.mobile430: pass — mature body volume reads correctly without crowding props or navigation.

solid-blue.mobile390: pass — largest silhouette remains grounded, centered, and clear of room props.
solid-blue.mobile430: pass — heavy body condition reads intentionally while staying proportional to the rug and room.

blue-white-bicolor.mobile390: pass — compact crescent sits directly on the rug and the white/blue identity remains readable.
blue-white-bicolor.mobile430: pass — baseline, scale, and prop clearances remain stable.

styleReview.evidence: All poses use restrained, desaturated naturalistic watercolor/dry-brush fur, soft alpha edges, and quiet contrast against the approved room. They intentionally preserve more breed anatomy and coat detail than the simplified chibi cat in style-ref-poses.png.
styleReview.userApprovalFocus: Confirm the chosen naturalistic watercolor detail level and the four relative body scales before any production promotion.

disposition: Stop at visual approval. Do not integrate, promote, replace Minho, edit app code, or commit.
